{{Quote|Her domain is very powerful. Her father has the ear of Supreme Overlord Shimrra, does he not?|Nom Anor to Harrar|<ref name="Hero's Trial" />}}
A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''domain''' of the [[priest caste]] was led by the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Jakan]]<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]<ref name="TERC" /> during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Members of the Yuuzhan Vong elite, the [[domain]] was very powerful due to its chief's position as [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]]. [[Elan]], the youngest daughter of Jakan and a [[Priestess/Legends|Priestess]] of [[Yun-Harla]] undertook a mission to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] members of the [[New Jedi Order]]. [[Gender/Legends|Her]] success on the mission would have brought even greater prosperity to her domain. Although Elan [[Death/Legends|died]] before she completed the mission,<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> the domain remained influential and her [[Parent/Legends|father]] was elevated to even greater power.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|135|Jakan}}</ref>
